v2 index with one bad entry keeps the previous v2 cache (whole-index validation)
GET /platform-update is always a 200 envelope with the frozen shape
manual refresh validates the fixed official index and caches the target atomically
manual refresh is throttled for 60s and does not re-check
concurrent refreshes share a single in-flight check
network failure keeps the last successful target and never blocks games
malformed or unbound indexes are rejected as invalid while keeping the last target
redirect downgrade and oversized indexes are rejected without a target
a 5s index timeout is enforced and surfaced as a retryable offline state
startup silent check runs only when the last attempt is older than 6h
same version with a different commit is reported as an anomaly
H1 route surface fails closed and client-report stores per-window identity
derived capability matrix follows the frozen HMR/dev/anomaly rules
health identity is frozen at activation (disk-new/running-old stays old)
/health exposes additive buildCommit/loadedVersion without regressing old fields
